notes: 放进 art/side/source/parts/<零件名>.png 再跑 python art/side/pack_parts.py，原画就顶替脚本画的同名零件；gear 开头分槽位的是护甲、护手、项链、戒指、鞋子的图标。风格：做旧实物（锈铁、旧铜、裂漆、旧骨、浑玉、麻、皮，低饱和、哑光、无纹饰）；布条、绳子、穗子一律褪色朱红。打包时无彩的部分当底子保留原色，朱红布绳分到一层按五行矿物色重染。透明底；兵器零件竖放、尖朝上、接口在底边正中；弓只画上半张弓臂。length、half_width 是素材空间单位，只作比例参考。

The object is worn, practical and clearly used: blackened or rust-stained iron, dull oxidised bronze, faded cloth, cracked lacquer, old bone, cloudy jade, hemp and leather. Strictly no chrome shine, no gold filigree, no gemstones, no glow, no sparkles, no ornate dragon scrollwork. Transparent background, no text, no legible characters, no seal stamps, no cast shadow, no hands, nothing else in the picture. Draw ONLY this one part, standing perfectly vertical, tip or top pointing straight UP, attachment end at the BOTTOM centre, centred horizontally, filling the frame height with a small margin. Part: straight double-edged jian blade with a raised central ridge, slight taper, no hilt. No tang, no collar or fittings: the blade ends cleanly in a straight cut at the bottom edge. Plain dull worn steel.
